mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates persistent monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that accelerate consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 1600) and retail sales (RSAFS > 600000) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through demand-led earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 600000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 270 signals persistent high inflation, triggering market anticipation of aggressive Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 270, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and expected earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS > 146000) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through demand-side earnings support.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 146000 and UNRATE < 5.5%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 270), persistent inflation expectations drive market fears of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through elevated discount rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 270, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts above 1600 (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction activity, signaling broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through confidence-driven equity demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600.
